Header: Xanthomonas campestris pv. musacearum banana bacterial wilt

Prevention: Do not transport banana out of infected area
Break off male flower bud part of banana by hand before flowering to prevent vectoring by bees
Or wrap up male part with polythene paper
If an area has been infected, crop rotation using any other crop besides banana for 5-10 years
Monitoring: Regularly visit banana plantation starting at least 6 months after planting
Observe 2-3 times per week for rotting fruits and drying of leaves
Take action when 1st infected plant is detected
Direct Control: Bury deeply or burn outside of the area of banana cultivation
Restrictions: MAFSC does not recommend the use of chemicals to control
